section_summary.extract_value: This section describes multiple regression analyses conducted separately for women and men, with emotional, psychological, and social well-being as criterion variables and body image variables, age, and BMI as predictors. The authors report that variance inflation factors (VIFs) were all ≤ 2.92, indicating no problematic multicollinearity. Full regression coefficients are presented in Table 3 (women) and Table 4 (men).
